notes.title: Rebound Rush Release
notes.content: [p]What began as a student project for the 2025 edition of the Ubisoft Game Lab Competition has grown into something much more.[/p][p][b]Rebound Rush[/b] was developed in just 10 weeks as part of the competition, during which it earned the [b]Best Art Direction[/b] award. Motivated by that recognition and the excitement surrounding the game, our team decided to take things further—polishing the experience, expanding the content, and preparing it for a full release.[/p][p]Today, we're thrilled to finally share it with you on Steam.[/p][p]Our small team of eight students put our hearts into every detail of this game. From the fast-paced gameplay to the hand-crafted visuals, Rebound Rush is the result of late nights, creativity, and passion. We truly hope you enjoy playing it as much as we loved making it.[/p][p]Thank you for your support—and welcome to the rush![/p]
